item.title: Former Civil War Field Hospital and Church. C. 1839. Three acres in Virginia. $525,000
item.description: There is a lot of history with this building! It started off as an Episcopal Church. During the Civil War it was used as a field hospital. In the 1950’s it was abandoned and left vacant. It was built in 1839. It is located on three acres in Goochland, Virginia. The church has been converted into a private residence. It features wide plank wood floors, built-in bookshelves, wainscoting, tall ceilings and exposed beams. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,246 square feet. $525,000 Contact Eliza Co

item.title: Pretty details! Nice stained glass! Two acres in Georgia. $245,000
item.description: This house has some pretty details! A lot of stained glass too. The house was built in 1899. It is located on 2.02 acres in Douglasville, Georgia. The house features a large covered front porch, upper porch, wood floors, stained glass windows, baseboards, picture rails, crystal chandeliers and an updated kitchen. There are a couple of storage sheds on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,292 square feet. $245,000 Contact Jennifer Cadwell with Sky High Realty From the Zillow listing:

item.title: Beautiful setting! Hummingbird Hills, on 66 acres in Idaho. $899,000
item.description: This is such a beautiful setting! Would be nice to have that much acreage. Hummingbird Hills was built in 1863. It is located on 66.98 acres in Garden Valley, Idaho. The house features a large deck, hot tub, wood floors, baseboards, buffet seating, wood stove and a large pantry. The property has a pond and a dock. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,590 square feet. $899,000 Contact Marta Paulson with A. V. West: 208-608-1880 From the Zillow listing: Garden Valley Homestead established 1863 on 6

item.title: Pretty stained glass! Former St. John’s Church. On 2 1/2 acres in Illinois. $125,000
item.description: Unique looking former church! Originally the St. John’s church. It was built in 1919. It is located on 2.5 acres in Aledo, Illinois. The church is now zoned residential. There is a large room with vaulted ceiling, some wood floors and pretty stained glass. Love the room with all of the stained glass windows. 4,996 square feet. $125,000 Contact Brittney Mills with Mel Foster: 309-798-8647 From the Zillow listing: BACK ON THE MARKET ! What an incredible opportunity to own a piece of history! Forme

item.title: Small cascading waterfall. Pretty interior. One acre in North Carolina. $249,000
item.description: There is a pretty cascading creek across the road from the house! The home has a pretty interior and a pretty setting. The house was built in 1957. It is located on one acre in Marshall, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, a large back patio, detached storage shed, wood floors, a lot of natural light and a vaulted ceiling. This house has been a successful short term rental. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 855 square feet. $249,000 Contact Franklin Smith with Asheville Crafte

item.title: “Azalea Acres”, 14 waterfront acres in Virginia. Has fruit trees. $599,900
item.description: Welcome to Azalea Acres! This waterfront property has some nice acreage! There are fruit trees on the property. The house was built in 1926. It is located on 14.47 acres in Port Haywood, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, some wood floors, baseboards, french doors, built-in bookshelves, stone hearth with wood stove and a spacious kitchen. item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Circa 1936 in Indiana. $199,900
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! I love the brick and wrought iron fencing out front! The house was built in 1936. It is located on .4 acre in Vincennes, Indiana. I wish there were more pictures of the interior and the exterior. The house features wood floors, nice door casements, crown moulding, pressed tin ceiling, chair rails, sunroom and an updated kitchen. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,894 square feet. $199,900 Contact Nanette Grumieaux with Heartland Real Estate:

item.title: This is cute! Four acres in Kentucky. $160,000
item.description: This is a cute house! It has some nice acreage with it. The house was built in 1938. It is located on four acres in London, Kentucky. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, wood walls, crown moulding, baseboards and a cute kitchen. There are two detached buildings on the property and both have electric. The property also has a carport. One bedroom, one bathroom and 804 square feet. $160,000 Contact William Hibbitts with Shawn Rogers Realty: 606-231-9586 From the Zillow l

item.title: Love the sunroom! Circa 1929 in Louisiana. $184,500
item.description: I love the sunroom! I would always be in there. The house was built in 1929. It is located on .25 acre in Opelousas, Louisiana. The house features an arched front door, original wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, spacious kitchen, crystal chandelier, sunroom and solid wood doors with original hardware. There is a fenced in backyard with a fireplace and carport. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,250 square feet. $184,500 Contact Charles Hiller with Parish Realty Acadiana: 337-735-1223 From

item.title: Former schoolhouse in Maine! Circa 1853. $275,000
item.description: This is a former schoolhouse! It’s a big space with over 6,000 square feet! The schoolhouse was built in 1853. It is located on .6 acre in Stockton Springs, Maine. The school features a bell tower, soaring ceilings and lots of windows for natural light. There are lots of possibilities with this building. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 6,244 square feet. $275,000 Contact RE/MAX Jaret and Cohn: belfast@jaretcohn.com From the Zillow listing: Bring your vision to this remarkable 1853 schoolhouse.
